verdict.rationale: Airbyte's first-party Terraform provider lets you version-control connection configuration as code. PyAirbyte lets pipelines be written in Python, and the Connector Builder sits on a low-code YAML format. However, the core platform is a stateful, UI-driven server that Terraform configures, not plain code that is itself the pipeline, and review and portability workflows are only implied. Missing for 10: documented git/PR review workflow, evidence that config is portable across instances or environments, depth beyond one-line Terraform and PyAirbyte mentions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, my pipelines are plain code and config in my own repository — versioned, reviewed, and portable like any software

citations.quote: you can use Airbyte's Terraform provider to automate and version control your Airbyte configuration as code
PyAirbyte brings the power of Airbyte to every Python and AI developer.
It provides an intuitive user interface on top of the low-code YAML format
